reason: £24.99 a jar is about five times what I pay for a tub of magnesium at Boots, and I have never tried magnesium, so I would be paying a lot to find out whether I like it. I might join the free waitlist to look, but I would not commit money this week.
objection: Why pay nearly £25 a jar for gummies when a Boots tub is about £5? I cannot tell from here whether the citrate form and the 180mg are worth that gap, and the sugar in a gummy is not something I want to take every day.
would_change_my_mind: A clear, checkable reason the citrate gummy is worth around five times a Boots tub, and a price for one jar closer to £10.
